title: Fail closed on UNKNOWN evidence during arbitration
objective: Make deterministic arbitration refuse ADVANCE whenever any frozen governing claim is UNKNOWN, even when a caller supplies a PASS assessment.
forbidden_actions: read or reuse credentials from chat
change evidence semantics beyond failing closed on explicit UNKNOWN claims
change a formal Foundry Program stage, route, gate, or evidence record
weaken authentication, authorization, approval, audit, secret scanning, or deterministic policy controls
deploy or authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or regulated action

acceptance_criteria.description: A frozen UNKNOWN claim plus a caller-supplied PASS assessment cannot produce eligible ADVANCE.
The invariant is enforced deterministically and without network or model behavior.
Existing kernel, Forge contract, secret, schema-drift, and package-build checks remain green on the refreshed exact head.
A distinct reviewer evaluates the exact refreshed head and base before protected integration.

protected_actions: approve or merge the pull request
change a therapeutic Program record or gate
